date: Enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
time: Enter a valid time in HH:mm:ss format (00:00:00–23:59:59).
requiredDate: Enter a date and time for this period.
pairedDate: Enter both dates, or clear both to show all records.
dateOrder: The end date and time must be the same as or later than the start.
parameterIds: Enter up to 25 positive integer parameter IDs, separated by commas.
eventCodes: Enter up to 25 non-negative integer event codes, separated by commas.
